verses.1: So that Zion will not be destroyed, and so that Jerusalem will not be desolate until its justice and redemption come.
verses.2: And nations will see your righteousness, and all kings will honor you. They will give you a new name, which the LORD will give to you.
verses.3: And you will be adorned with glory in the hand of Jehovah, and you will be a symbol of kingship in the hand of your God.
verses.4: It will not be said to you yet, “She has left.” And in your land, it will not be said yet, “She is still there.” For it is your desire that she be taken away from there. And in your land, it will happen, for Jehovah desires this for you and your land.
verses.5: For he who chooses a wife from among the daughters of men, his sons will also choose wives from among those women. And the bridegroom will be burdened by all these responsibilities upon his shoulders. O God of my Lord!
verses.6: Over your cities, Jerusalem, I have appointed guards who will keep watch day and night. They must never allow those who remember Jehovah to be harmed by me.
verses.7: And do not give him my blood until he has prepared the city for us to take it by force.
verses.8: May the LORD bless us in His name, and with His strength. If I give you your crops before they’re eaten by your enemies, and if the foreigners eat what you’ve worked hard to produce, then you will suffer greatly.
verses.9: For those who gather together, they will eat it and praise Jehovah. And those who dig it up, they will be buried in my holy courts.
verses.10: Go, go through the gates! Turn around and face the people. They were lifted up from the ground; they were brought forth from the earth.
verses.11: Now, Jehovah has spoken to the ends of the earth. He says to the daughter of Zion: “Now, your reward and your actions will be revealed before him.”
verses.12: And the people of the Holy One, God’s chosen ones were called “Goyei Yehovah.” And you will be called “Druisha” – a city that will never be abandoned.
